references.text: Jesus again expresses that his mission is primarily directed toward the people of Israel, which aligns with the instructions he gave to the twelve disciples in Matthew 10:5.

After Jesus' resurrection and before his ascension, he gives the disciples a new mission that expands their field of work beyond the borders of Israel, showing an evolution from the original instructions in Matthew 10:5.

Philip's evangelism in Samaria shows a change in missionary strategy compared to the original instructions Jesus gave in Matthew 10:5, where he said they should not go into the cities of the Samaritans.
